info.title: Lumira Finance local trial API
info.description: Finance plugin contract against the pinned platform, implementing a bounded slice of V4 / 4.0.0. Historical V3 records and evidence are retained separately. Requires session cookie and host CSRF protection. Tenant/book/year membership is rechecked on reads, writes and idempotent replay. Strict CNY literals allow at most2 fractional digits; internal amounts use28,8, legacy years are read-only, and annual watermarks commit transactionally. Product SDK camelCase/date/accountId/version/type are not a full adapter for reference snake_case accounting_date/account_version_id/content_version/closing_type/correction_kind or all43 reference operations. External filing/payment/AI execution, delta-opening, complete cash/year-close natural-person protocols and application RLS remain unimplemented. Source/effect/local Outbox 0.3.0 is installed and verified as a bounded draft/projection slice. Cash-scope qualification 0.4.0 is installed and verified as a monthly qualification-only slice. Actual-cash registration/matching 0.5.0 is installed and verified as an unreviewed source/match/tombstone slice. Match-only correction and independent withdrawal 0.6.0 is installed and verified as a bounded unused-source preparation slice; formal reports remain blocked. Ordinary cash classification policy0.7.0 is installed and bounded PG/HTTP/browser verified; it publishes/retires ordinary purpose policies only and does not consume claims, review individual sources, allocate or generate reports. Human source fact review0.8 is installed and bounded PG/HTTP/browser verified; real typed reliance, independent release and re-review do not classify Raw, verify banks or contribute reports. One initial host plugin-registration loading window recovered with ordinary reload and remains documented. Ordinary per-component cash allocation0.9 is installed and bounded PG/HTTP/browser verified, including real typed dependency release and atomic same-parent replacement. No complete cash coverage, working paper or formal report capability follows. Ledger cash coverage difference preview0.10 is installed and bounded PG/HTTP/browser verified, including the whole declared-scope posted-line population, missing chains, current dependence and stale-page handling. It is a point-in-time read-only diagnostic within declared approved scope, not a frozen approved working package, complete external cash universe or formal report. Journal and account-ledger read pagination0.11 is installed and bounded PG/HTTP/browser verified, including forward/backward enumeration beyond200, unique ledger lines, precise legacy read and context reset. New bounded keyset pages preserve legacy array interfaces and full authoritative trial/closing calculations; technical generation0 is not business count or historical posting sequence, and million-scale capacity is not established. Manual NORMAL person separation0.14 and independent evidence usage0.15.1 retain their accepted scope. Finance0.16 is now bounded QA accepted for person-mode CNY PROFIT_LOSS, YEAR_END current-profit transfer and exact full transfer reversal, including actual residual supplements and same-body retries. Annual BASE/DELTA/opening transmission, full period/year close prerequisites, archival, formal statements and production capacity remain incomplete. Dual-year carry-readiness0.17 is bounded QA accepted as read-only observation; approved mapping, BASE/DELTA, formal opening, annual close/archive and formal reports remain blocked. Candidate0.18.1 repairs authorized duplicate identity references through a compatible typed-error extension and existing SDK issue consumption. Original0.18.0 full/HTTP/browser evidence retains its original artifact epoch; it is not re-labelled as0.18.1 execution. Partial MD02 organization master data0.18.1 is bounded QA accepted with compatible SDK-visible authorized duplicate references; bank/payment/GL-accounting consumption, government verification and complete V4 remain outside this slice. V4 0.21.0 integrates receivables (AR01/AR02, V20), fixed/intangible asset subledger (FA01/IA01, V21), payroll & IIT cumulative withholding (PR01/IIT01, V22), formal CAS/SMALL financial statement calculation & source engine (RPT01/RPT02), tax obligation lifecycle domain (TAX01/VAT01/CIT01), and offline regulatory archive bundle verifier (ARC01/ARC02). V4 0.22.0/0.22.1 (V23-V24) promotes all 6 V4 lanes into durable PostgreSQL 18 + HTTP + UI runtime: AR01/AR02 accounting/tax decisions & native AR_* journals, FA01/IA01 asset source quotas, native ASSET_* journals, GL reconciliation & plain-decimal serialization, PR01/IIT01 DB-backed payroll rule packs, employments, YTD baselines & verified fact evidences, TAX01/TAX05/TAX06 Tax Obligations & Offline Receipt Reconciliation (three-person SoD, global receipt uniqueness, officialCapability=NOT_VERIFIED, paymentState=NOT_ASSESSED), ARC01/ARC03 Offline Regulatory Archive & Diagnostic POSIX ustar Package Generator/Verifier (legalArchiveComplete=false, cross-verified by archive-package.mjs), and RP01/RPT02-RPT05 Report Draft Semantic Mapping & Blocked-Draft Ledger Evaluation (formal /reports remains RULE_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE), plus FinanceStrictJson closed-schema zero-coercion deserialization and UI 4xx retry-lock recovery.
